basis.time: Engineering allowance from one complete 64.53-second measurement, with headroom for startup/cache/load. It is not a statistical interval or a measured remote-runner forecast.
basis.memory: 2 GiB reservation exceeds 3 times the observed simultaneous group RSS; sampled transients and interpreter/library differences require headroom.
basis.disk: 1 GiB extra is over 3 times the 276 MB newly generated files; preinstalled data, dependencies, repository and archives are separate.

environment_comparison.measured_host: INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C, current execution environment

excluded: installation/download/build of dependencies and Planck data
production SU3 geometry or equilibrium mixing pilot
nuisance profile or CMB precision campaign
